instruction: Build a production-ready Fastify microservice with security and operational concerns
relevant_when: Agent builds a Fastify service intended for production deployment
context: Proactively check that the agent applies production hardening patterns: CORS with explicit origins, helmet for security headers, rate limiting, structured pino logging, and graceful shutdown with signal handling and onClose hooks for cleanup.

checklist.name: cors-registered
checklist.rule: Agent registers @fastify/cors with explicit origin configuration, not just cors() with no options (which allows all origins)
checklist.relevant_when: Agent sets up a Fastify server that serves API requests

checklist.name: helmet-registered
checklist.rule: Agent registers @fastify/helmet for security headers (Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, etc.)
checklist.relevant_when: Agent sets up a Fastify server for production

checklist.name: rate-limit-registered
checklist.rule: Agent registers @fastify/rate-limit with a max requests and time window configuration to prevent abuse
checklist.relevant_when: Agent sets up a Fastify server that accepts external requests

checklist.name: pino-logger-enabled
checklist.rule: Fastify is instantiated with logger: true or a pino logger configuration object. The agent uses request.log and app.log throughout, never console.log

checklist.name: graceful-shutdown-signals
checklist.rule: Agent handles SIGINT and/or SIGTERM process signals by calling app.close() to drain in-flight requests and run cleanup hooks
checklist.relevant_when: Agent sets up a Fastify server

checklist.name: onclose-cleanup-hooks
checklist.rule: Agent registers onClose hooks to clean up resources (database connections, cache clients, etc.) that are closed when app.close() is called
checklist.relevant_when: Agent registers database or cache connections with Fastify

checklist.name: listen-with-host
checklist.rule: Agent calls app.listen() with host: '0.0.0.0' for containerized/production deployments, not just a port number
checklist.relevant_when: Agent starts a Fastify server intended for production or Docker
